moglie.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic woman in her fifties, short, broad and sturdy, healthy and solid: a big round head, a severe jet-black bob, a heavy frowning brow with thick dark eyebrows, small dark suspicious eyes, a big bulbous nose, a small downturned mouth and full cheeks; in a dark green knitted cardigan over a grey top and a dark skirt, thick tights and brown shoes

parti.occhi: Small, dark, suspicious eyes under a heavy frowning brow and thick dark eyebrows; the whites a little red at the rims, as after a sleepless night shift: no fever, no sweat.
parti.bocca: A small, tight, downturned mouth with healthy teeth; nothing unusual.

collo.inquadratura: the side of her neck and the skin behind her ear, her black bob pulled back
collo.segni: Two thin red lines pressed into the skin behind the ear and across the cheek, like the marks left by the elastic straps of a protective face mask worn for many hours; no swelling, no lumps.

mani.inquadratura: both hands held out in front, backs up, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Rough, chapped, reddened hands with cracked knuckles, as from strong disinfectant; on the back of the right hand a faded blue ink stamp: a small triangle with a number inside, like an entry stamp.

marito.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic big old man in his seventies, heavy and broad, sturdy rather than thin: a big bald head with a fringe of grey hair at the sides, large ears, heavy bushy brows over small tired eyes, a big bulbous nose, a thick white walrus moustache and a heavy jaw; in a white vest, wrapped in a green and brown patterned wool blanket, the plastic mask of a nebulizer on a green cord hanging on his chest

parti.occhi: Small, deep-set old eyes under heavy bushy brows; the whites are clear: no fever, no sweat.

occhi_febbre.inquadratura: the eyes and the bridge of the nose, from the eyebrows to the cheekbones
occhi_febbre.segni: His small eyes are glassy and bloodshot with high fever, the rims red, beads of sweat on his bald forehead and temples.

parti.bocca: Under the thick white walrus moustache, faintly purplish lips, the mouth half open as he breathes with effort; on the lower lip a little thick grey phlegm, no blood.
parti.collo: A thick, wrinkled old neck, the tendons straining with each breath; no swelling, no lumps.

collo_febbre.inquadratura: the side of the neck, from under the jaw to the collarbone
collo_febbre.segni: A thick, wrinkled old neck; under the jaw a hard, swollen lump the size of a walnut, red and shiny: a plague bubo just beginning.

mani.inquadratura: both hands resting on his knees, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Big, heavy hands with thick fingers; the fingertips are swollen, broad and rounded like spatulas, the nails curved over them, and the nail beds are clearly bluish-purple, as from years of too little air; old white scars from quarry work.
